hero.title: Tell us what you need to build
hero.description: Fill in the form and our team will review your project to send you a tailored proposal.

selector.title: What do you need to build?
selector.description: Pick an option. We explain what it includes before you continue.

tinglado.name: Open-sided shed
tinglado.short: Steel structure with columns and a sheet-metal roof. Usually open on the sides.
tinglado.full: Steel structure made up of columns, roof framing and a sheet-metal roof. It is usually open on its sides.
tinglado.ideal: Open storage, parking, loading areas, machinery protection or production spaces.

galpon.name: Industrial warehouse
galpon.short: Roofed building closed with sheet metal and/or masonry.
galpon.full: Steel building roofed and closed on its sides with sheet metal and/or masonry. It can include an industrial floor, gates, insulation and other add-ons.
galpon.ideal: Warehouses, factories, workshops and distribution centres.

nave.name: Industrial plant
nave.short: Industrial building designed around your activity.
nave.full: Industrial building designed as a whole around the activity that will take place inside. It can include structure, cladding, floor, services, offices, docks and operating areas.
nave.ideal: Production plants, logistics and more complex industrial projects.

estructura.name: Steel structure
estructura.short: Fabrication and/or erection of the load-bearing structure.
estructura.full: Fabrication and/or erection of the project's load-bearing structure, without necessarily including roofing, cladding or civil works.
estructura.ideal: When you only need the structure.

ampliacion.name: Warehouse extension
ampliacion.full: Extension of an existing building to add covered area, height or operating capacity. We will ask for measurements and, if you have them, drawings of the current structure.
ampliacion.ideal: Adding covered area, height or operating capacity.

piso.name: Industrial floor
piso.short: Concrete floor for industrial traffic and operation.
piso.full: Concrete floor prepared for traffic, storage or industrial activity, with the finish the project requires.

movimiento.name: Earthworks
movimiento.short: Preparing and levelling the site before building.
movimiento.full: Preparation, levelling, excavation, filling and compaction of the site before the works begin.
movimiento.ideal: Preparing the site for floors, foundations, yards or new buildings.

obraCivil.name: Civil works / masonry
obraCivil.short: Foundations, footings, walls and civil works.
obraCivil.full: Foundations, footings, walls, masonry and other civil works related to the project.
obraCivil.ideal: Completing the civil work packages of your project.

llaveEnMano.name: Turnkey project
llaveEnMano.short: End-to-end solution coordinated by NyG at every stage.
llaveEnMano.full: End-to-end solution where NyG Estructuras coordinates the contracted stages of the project through to handover.
llaveEnMano.ideal: Anyone looking for a single point of responsibility.

otro.name: Other project
otro.full: For extensions, refurbishments or special works that do not fit the categories above.
otro.ideal: Tell us briefly what you need.

details.title: Tell us about your project
details.description: Approximate figures are fine: they help us size the proposal.
details.areaHint: The area is calculated from the width and the length.

context.title: Where is the site?
context.description: With the location and timing we can estimate logistics and availability.

contact.title: How should we reach you?
contact.description: Last step: leave us your details and we will get back to you shortly.
contact.privacy: Your data is protected. We do not share your information with third parties.

summary.title: Review your request before sending
